C0335.title: Double 11 Investigation: IoT SIM Card Abuse on E-Commerce Platforms Under Tightened Regulations
C0335.summary: During the 2022 Double 11 shopping festival, an investigation uncovered widespread abuse of IoT SIM cards on e-commerce platforms. Activation required registering on an IoT management platform called 'Wuxianji Communication', and such cards were often used for fraudulent registration of internet accounts, posing regulatory risks.

references.title: Double 11 investigation: IoT cards under strict regulation—rampant e-commerce sales, hidden dangers
